name: Tianzhou-5
about: Tianzhou-5 (2022-152A), a crewed vehicle (Tianzhou), launched 2022 Nov 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2022 Nov 12), held fixed
docked to S48274; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
